title: "Cloudflare AI Gateway"
description: "Cloudflare's proxy in front of the other AI providers: logs, caching, rate limits and spend, with each provider's own key."
---

Not a model provider of its own: once it's on, model calls to providers it supports pass through Cloudflare AI Gateway, in your account, for its logs, caching and analytics. Your keys stay on the Gateway.

## Turn it on

- **Open it here:** [dash.cloudflare.com](https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/:account/ai/ai-gateway)
- **API reference:** [developers.cloudflare.com](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-gateway/)

### Steps

1. Run `pnpm everyapp ai gateway on`. It finds or creates an AI Gateway named `everyapp` in your account and turns it on. Nothing to copy.
2. Optional: to require a token, open the AI Gateway in the dashboard, **Settings → Authenticated Gateway**, turn it on and create a token. Then set it with `pnpm everyapp secret set AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY`.

### Check it worked

- `pnpm everyapp secret list` lists `AI_GATEWAY_ID`, and the AI Gateway's dashboard shows the calls your apps make.
